translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Rita maber, yaye Nyasaye
nikech in e kar pondona.
Ne awacho ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “In e Ruodha;
onge gima ber machielo ma an-go makmana in.”
To jomaler manie piny,
to gin kaka joma nigi duongʼ ma ahero gi chunya duto.
Joma lawo nyiseche mamoko
kuyo margi biro medore.
Misengini magi mag remo ok abi olo oko
kendo kata nying-gi ok abi hulo gi dhoga.
Jehova Nyasaye, isemiya pok makora kod okombena;
iserita maber gi giga duto.
Kiepena duto ochopo kuonde mabeyo;
adier, girkeni maga duto moro wangʼ adier.
Abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye mangʼadona rieko;
kata gotieno chunya puonja.
Asiko aketo Jehova Nyasaye e nyima ndalo duto.
Nikech ka entie e lweta korachwich,
to onge gima nyalo yienga.
Emomiyo chunya mor kendo lewa yot;
ringra bende biro yweyo gi kwe,
nikech ok inijwangʼa ei liel,
to bende ok niyie Ngʼati Maler tow.
Isenyisa yor ngima;
inipongʼa gi mor mogundho ka an e nyimi,
kendo gi mor mosiko e badi korachwich.

footnotes.text: Miktam: en kit wer mane Daudi wero.
